searchText: Did participation drop by ~20% or am I misinterpreting this? lots of missed slots too and lots of orphaned blocks Yeah, to cross-link discussions, https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/892088344438255616/1445983434106474627 shows late block arrival times ramping up, presumably thus orphaning Not liekly due orphaning in meaning of missed slots. two consequitive canonical blocks were delivered in delays of 200-400seconds in extreme cases. participation climbing back up some >83% Slot seem to not to have the delays anymore no more forks now thats all good news yeah still some orphaned slots, but no long range forks ~86% just to close the loop here, it looks like we are back to usual operations thanks again to the Prysm team for quickly identifying and resolving the issue, very nice work 🙂 i expect to close this channel later today ok, will archive this channel everyone thanks again for all of your hard work that got us this far with a smooth upgrade, this is a big deal for ethereum!
